title: SPE — Introduction
_comment: Narration beats for cards/intro.html (~35 s spoken; Chirp runs ~2.2 words/s, so keep each beat ≤ 15 words). Beat i runs while scene i is spoken; the page lays its animation out from the measured durations. Rebuild: RESYNTH=1 bash scripts/make-series.sh cards

scenes.narr: Simple PHP Engine is a PHP 8.5 tutorial: one small web app, built nine times.
Each chapter adds exactly one idea, as a strict diff of the one before it.
No framework, no dependencies: plain modern PHP that people, and AI agents, can read.
From chapter three, every request is four validated parameters: object, method, id, and export.
It runs on PHP's built-in server, with SQLite from chapter seven. Nothing to install but PHP.
Nine chapters, two minutes each. Let's start.
